items.title: Gucci's new 'Made in China' sneaker breaks with Italian tradition
items.summary: Reuters reported Gucci's Demna-designed Drip sneaker (about EUR800) and a slip-on leather model are labelled Made in China, observed on tags in a Paris store; Gucci says Italy remains central to its identity but the Chinese partner had the needed technological capability, while Berenberg analysts flagged tension between provenance and the luxury positioning Gucci is trying to reclaim.

items.title: Why Gucci's 'Made in China' sneakers are raising questions
items.summary: Follow-up analysis piece (published October 1) revisits the Drip sneaker sourcing controversy a week on, framing it as a test of whether cheaper, China-made entry products can coexist with Gucci's push to win back middle-class shoppers without further eroding perceived luxury positioning.

items.title: Kering-Aktie nachboerslich bei 35,41 Euro: minus 2,45 Prozent
items.summary: Kering shares fell 2.45% in German after-hours trading to EUR35.41 (note: differs from Paris-listed price convention), with commentary tying the move to investors weighing the Gucci sneaker-sourcing controversy against CEO Luca de Meo's reassurances on Italian manufacturing commitment.

items.title: Kering (KER) Euronext Paris trading update, 2 October 2026
items.summary: Kering shares traded modestly higher intraday on Euronext Paris on 2 October, with technical commentary describing the medium-term trend as still bearish even as the stock shows early signs the recent downward phase may be stabilizing; investor attention remains on the Gucci turnaround trajectory under de Meo and Bellettini.

items.title: Gucci Memoria at Milan Design Week 2026: Demna disrupts the Fuorisalone
items.summary: Italian design-press review of Demna's Memoria exhibition praises its immersive treatment of Gucci's 105-year heritage but raises a critical structural point: fashion's growing takeover of Design Week risks stripping design discourse of narrative depth in favor of brand spectacle, calling the Gucci/Nike-dominated week a sign design is 'on the verge of extinction' as an independent discipline.

items.title: "Unpopular Gucci Opinions" thread, PurseForum Gucci subforum
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum thread dedicated to contrarian takes on Gucci continues to see fresh posts alongside adjacent active threads ('Appreciation for Gucci quality', bag-defect/repair complaints), reflecting a split community mood between loyalists defending craftsmanship and members airing quality and value-for-money grievances under Demna's pricing.

items.title: Trustpilot Italia: recensioni negative su boutique e ordini online Gucci
items.summary: Recent Italian Trustpilot reviews describe the Gucci Monte Napoleone boutique as visually impressive but with inconsistent service toward customers not spending large sums, plus a durability complaint about a bag deteriorating within a few years without a store remedy, and separate complaints about damaged or incomplete online orders.

items.title: Vogue Instagram video of Kate Moss's Gucci backless/thong-detail look draws split reaction
items.summary: Public comments on Vogue's Instagram video of Kate Moss's Demna-designed Gucci look remain split days after the show: some call her an 'icon', but many criticize the fit and styling, with one widely-echoed comment arguing the designer 'failed' her despite her figure, illustrating continued mixed sentiment around the FW26 'Primavera' show.

items.title: X post on Gucci's $1,000 'Made in China' sneakers circulates amid pricing backlash
items.summary: A widely circulated X post flagging that Gucci's new $1,000 sneaker is labelled Made in China helped fuel social backlash over paying luxury prices for China-manufactured goods; secondary coverage notes the disconnect is especially charged given Gucci's recent double-digit revenue decline, though exact engagement counts on the original post were not visible.

items.title: De Meo: 'Kering Accademia per le Eccellenze parte, 85% della nostra produzione e in Italia'
items.summary: Kering CEO Luca de Meo opened the group's new artisan training academy in Milan (1,500 students, 40 programs spanning Bottega Veneta, Brioni, Gucci and Pomellato training centers) and stated 85% of group production stays in Italy, directly countering the 'Made in China' sneaker backlash and ruling out relocating production.

items.title: Forum members review the 'vulgar' Gucci Spring 2027 collection from Demna
items.summary: Roundup of fashion-forum member reactions to Demna's SS27 'Store Show' remains overwhelmingly negative days after the show, with posters calling it 'pure vulgarity, paired with an absolute lack of vision' and 'a pile of nothingness', with one comparing it unfavorably to DSquared2 and predicting a short tenure for Demna if the direction continues.

items.title: La lecon de Gucci: en 2026, le luxe sera emotionnel ou ne sera pas
items.summary: French luxury-trade commentary argues Demna's 'Primavera' collection proves emotional storytelling, not product logic alone, is now the key driver of desirability in luxury, framing Gucci's FW26 relaunch as a template other Kering-owned and rival maisons will need to follow to regain cultural relevance.
